positive.prompt: Before we plan this change, check the code knowledge graph: what calls validateUser and which execution flows break if I change it?
Use GitNexus to give me the blast radius of refactoring the session service before I write the spec
Is the GitNexus index for this repo stale? Re-index it and tell me every caller of toError that the plan has to cover
I have a grep list of who uses this function but I'm not sure it's complete — run an impact analysis on it before we break the work into tasks
Before I commit, check that my diff only affects what the plan's impact report said it would and that every caller got a test

negative.prompt: Write a spec for a brand-new billing module that has no code yet
Break this PRD into ordered implementation tasks with acceptance criteria
The checkout test fails intermittently — find the root cause

evals.prompt: We need validateUser in src/validate.js to also return false unless user.emailVerified === true. Before any code is written, plan the change so every place that depends on validateUser keeps working and is covered by tests.
evals.expected_output: A plan whose dependency graph is grounded in an explicit impact gate: either a GitNexus-derived Impact Report (index freshness stated, safe re-index used) or a one-line statement that GitNexus is unavailable with a source-derived dependency map; loginHandler and apiMiddleware identified as direct dependents, the registerRoutes handler wiring and the /api/report route identified as blind spots the call graph cannot see; each dependent mapped to a task or acceptance criterion with a test; risk rated with a reason and the auth path not rated LOW on caller count alone
expectations: The plan states explicitly whether a GitNexus knowledge graph was available. If it was not, it contains a line saying GitNexus is unavailable and that the dependency map is source-derived, and it contains no fabricated graph output (no invented depth tables, confidence percentages, or process names)
If GitNexus was available, the plan records the indexed commit or freshness and any indexing was run with the --index-only flag, never plain analyze

loginHandler (src/login.js) and apiMiddleware (src/middleware.js) are listed as direct dependents of validateUser, and registerRoutes passing the handlers by reference plus the /api/report route gated by apiMiddleware are called out as dependents that a call graph or name grep does not show
Every listed dependent maps to at least one task or acceptance criterion that names a test for it (login rejection, middleware rejection, route wiring)
A risk level is stated with a reason; the auth-gating nature of the change is named and the risk is not rated LOW merely because few callers were found
